description: This file defines utility functions for creating lazy-loaded runtime modules and surfaces, enabling deferred and cached access to dynamically imported modules and their exports.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeSurface<TModule, TSurface>( createLazyRuntimeSurface
methods.description: Creates a cached surface that lazily loads and selects a surface from a dynamically imported module.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeModule<TModule>( createLazyRuntimeModule
methods.description: Creates a cached loader for the entire module, avoiding repeated dynamic imports.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeNamedExport<TModule, const TKey extends keyof TModule>( createLazyRuntimeNamedExport
methods.description: Creates a cached loader for a specific named export of a dynamically imported module.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeMethod<TSurface, TArgs extends unknown[], TResult>( createLazyRuntimeMethod
methods.description: Creates a wrapper that lazily loads a surface and invokes a selected method with arguments.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeMethodBinder<TSurface>(load: () => Promise<TSurface>) { createLazyRuntimeMethodBinder
methods.description: Returns a function to create lazily loaded methods bound to a specific surface loader.

ctags.name: createLazyRuntimeNamedExport
ctags.pattern: /^export function createLazyRuntimeNamedExport<TModule, const TKey extends keyof TModule>($/
